basic_info.description: This one bedroom one bath at Daniel Burnham Court located in the heart of the city will leave you feeling relaxed and at home. Boasting a completely renovated kitchen with stainless steel appliances. This bright and spacious home also features modern furniture, cozy plush carpeting throughout and custom built-ins unique to this apartment. Featuring beautiful city views. Secured parking, high speed Internet and bi-monthly housekeeping services are also included. Month to Month
